headline: Red Wings activate Marco Kasper, Mason Appleton off IR
take:
Detroit gets two forwards back at a moment it needs bodies more than answers. Daily Faceoff reports Marco Kasper and Mason Appleton are off injured reserve; Kasper has played one game this season, Appleton two. With Dylan Larkin refusing to play until he's traded, the Red Wings' forward group has been thin all fall.

Don't read much into the tiny samples, though they're friendly: Detroit had 71% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with Kasper on the ice in his one game and 73% with Appleton. The bigger problem is finishing. The Wings are 7-8-3 and have scored 11.1 fewer goals than their chances deserve, the kind of gap that tends to close. Kasper, the eighth pick in 2022, scored nine goals last season. If he gets real minutes, he's the more interesting of the two.
